maria-docs: Draft PR to update audit export guidance and SDK migration (tenant -> tenant_hash + redaction options). https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/920 (draft). Need SOC2 wording + short SDK examples.
jon: paste current example so i can swap.
maria-docs: current sample: ```json {\"tenant_id\": \"org_123\", \"actor_email\": \"sam@example.com\", \"action\": \"delete\"} ```
liam: auditors don't like raw tenant_id in examples. Recommend tenant_hash and call out pseudonymization vs redaction.
mia-legal: Legal suggestion: "Audit exports may emit pseudonymized identifiers (tenant_hash) or irreversible redacted fields. Pseudonymization uses a secret-salted HMAC-SHA256; mapping tables, if retained, are access-restricted and access to them is audited (audited access controls). Audit exports are encrypted at rest. Default retention is 90 days; customers can configure export.retention_days."
zoe: will add a short python SDK snippet converting tenant -> tenant_hash and a JS snippet for redaction flag. Also running link-checker for anchors.
ci-bot: Preview for PR 920: https://deploy.previews.redwood/920 build OK; link-check found broken anchor: api-reference#audit-exports -> pushed nav fix.
zoe: python snippet added in PR:
```python
import hashlib
salt = get_salt_from_kms()  # retrieve salt from KMS/HSM
tenant_hash = hashlib.sha256(salt + b"tenant:acme").hexdigest()
client.audit.log_event(tenant_hash=tenant_hash, actor=None, action='delete')
# do NOT include raw tenant_id in logs or exports
```
jon: nice. Add one-line FAQ: "Why tenant_hash?" -> reduce PII in logs, simplify SOC2 evidence.
maria-docs: added FAQ + retention example and changelog note under migration v2.1. CI green after nav fix.
mia-legal: LGTM with the exact wording about 'audited access controls' retained. :white_check_mark:
jon: merging once CI is green. Any other blockers?
zoe: none from docs side. small follow-up: add enterprise note for on-prem mapping tables.
maria-docs: merged. :shipit: closing thread.
jon: thanks everyone.
zoe: thanks!
